utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is still on for this weekend, and they’re hoping a few more folks can pitch in. If you want, I can pass along the details I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely still happening this weekend? If you’ve got the details, please pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s definitely still on this weekend. I’ll send you the time, place, and what they still need help with.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring what they can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — that’d be really helpful. I’m a bit scattered, so I appreciate you keeping it on people’s radar.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep mentioning it around the block and make sure folks know it’s coming up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — the front gate is the biggest priority right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check the front gate first and see what parts we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help a little, if that’s useful. What part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we’re short on screws, tape, and one good wrench. If you can grab any of those, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring screws and tape. I’ll check back if I can find a wrench too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around school pickup and drop-off. What time does the repair drive need me there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that’d be a big help. Let me check the timing and I’ll get right back to you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let’s keep it simple—what’s the plan, and when do you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli — I’m still sorting the details, but I’d like to keep it simple too. I’ll let you know the time as soon as I pin it down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just let me know the time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive — you should come by and bring a friend if you can!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might stop by, but I’ll need to check the timing first and see if I can arrange a ride.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally, just let me know what works for you — I can also help figure out a ride if that makes it easier!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up — what should I know?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’re gathering small repairs folks need help with, like leaky taps, loose handles, and the like. If you tell me what’s needed, I’ll add it to the list and make sure it gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great — I’ve got a loose kitchen handle and a dripping bathroom tap. Please add both to the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — before I help, can you tell me exactly what needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We need to fix the loose fence panel by the alley, patch the cracked walkway near the mailbox, and check the porch light at the corner house.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got the list: fence panel by the alley, cracked walkway near the mailbox, and the porch light at the corner house. I’ll check them in that order.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can put something aside for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll let you know what they still need most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — just send word when you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Could I borrow a hammer and some screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can lend you a hammer and a set of screwdrivers. I’ll bring them by when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m heading to the repair drive now and I’ll keep track of where things go. If you need anything set aside, let me know before I leave.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — if you see a spare screwdriver or a small Phillips set, could you set it aside for me? I’ll swing by later.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll set aside any spare screwdriver or small Phillips set I find and keep track of it for you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a few tools for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would help a lot, Gus. Thanks — I’ll make sure we can use them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I’ll drop them by before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s handling the pickups. Do you know where we should start with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—can you confirm who’s coordinating the pickups? Then we can figure out where to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check on that, but I need a clear contact first so we don’t lose track of the pickups.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bring everyone together for the repair drive. What do you want me to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you organize the sign-up sheet and let folks know what tools or supplies to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll set up the sign-up sheet and share a simple list of needed tools and supplies with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of supplies for the repair drive—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running late as usual, but I can grab screws, duct tape, and a box of gloves. What else would help most?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That covers a big chunk—thank you. If you can also grab a couple rolls of painter’s tape and a utility knife, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout — folks are dropping off tools and supplies already. If you’ve got anything to spare, it sounds like today’s a good day to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — I can swing by after school pickup and drop off a few things. Thanks for letting me know!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an ear out for any other donations coming in and let you know if they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Could you help me keep track of volunteer names and tools? I’ll handle the sign-up sheet and we can compare notes before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can keep track of the volunteer names and tools. Just send me your notes when you have them, and we’ll compare before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you help sort donations and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and label the boxes. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please, I’d appreciate that—I’m still catching up on it from second-hand info.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details right now, and I can keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive location yet, but I can keep an eye out and tell you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Just let me know when you find it, and I’ll plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll do that—if I spot the repair drive location, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you decide what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — I’m still checking the details before I say for sure. Can you remind me what’s on the list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I was thinking the porch step, the loose fence panel, and the kitchen sink leak. Want me to help you check the rest?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I can spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll get the repair drive details ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let folks know when I’m out and about.
